مُشَايِعٌ Overtaking, or coming up with another or others; or one that overtakes, &c.: (S, K, TA:) as in the saying of Lebeed, “كَمَا ضَمَّ أُخْرَى التَّالِيَاتِ المُشَايِعُ
” [Like as he that overtakes collects together the last of those cattle that go behind the others]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
